EmailTemplate.description: Approval notification sent to applicant when membership is approved
EmailTemplate.name: CVMA Membership Approved Notification
EmailTemplate.subject: 🏍️ WELCOME TO CVMA! Your Membership Has Been Approved
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Congratulations {!Membership_Application__c.Applicant_First_Name__c}!
We are proud to welcome you to the Combat Veterans Motorcycle Association (CVMA) Chapter 20-7 family!
YOUR MEMBERSHIP DETAILS: - Membership ID: {!Membership_Application__c.Membership_ID_Generated__c} - Member Since: {!Membership_Application__c.Processing_Date__c} - Membership Level: {!Membership_Application__c.Membership_Level__c} - Chapter: Chapter 20-7 - Jacksonville, FL
NEXT STEPS: 1. WELCOME MEETING: Attend our next chapter meeting to receive your official welcome 2. MEMBER ORIENTATION: Complete new member orientation and brotherhood introduction 3. EVENTS ACCESS: You now have access to all CVMA Chapter 20-7 events and rides 4. COMMUNICATION: You will be added to our member communication channels 5. MERCHANDISE: Contact us about ordering your CVMA patches and gear
UPCOMING EVENTS: Check your email for invitations to upcoming chapter meetings, rides, and social events.
MEMBER RESOURCES: - Chapter Website: www.cvma20-7.org - Member Portal: Access through our Salesforce community - Emergency Contacts: Available in your member profile
BROTHERHOOD COMMITMENT: As a CVMA member, you join a brotherhood dedicated to "Vets Serving Vets." We support each other, our families, and our community through: - Veteran advocacy and support - Community service and charity rides - Brotherhood and camaraderie - Motorcycle safety and riding events
CONTACT YOUR OFFICERS: If you have any questions or need assistance, please reach out: - Email: officers@cvma20-7.org - Phone: (904) 555-CVMA
Welcome to the family, Brother/Sister!
Vets Serving Vets Combat Veterans Motorcycle Association Chapter 20-7 - Jacksonville, FL
"Honor the Fallen, Help the Living"
